spec.description:
List earn strategies along with their parameters.

Requires a valid API key but no specific permission is required.

Returns only strategies that are available to the user based on geographic region.

When the user does not meet the tier restriction, `can_allocate` will be false and `allocation_restriction_info` indicates `Tier` as the restriction reason. Earn products generally require Intermediate tier.

A note about `lock_type`:
- `instant`: can be deallocated without an unbonding period. Called flexible in the UI.
- `bonded`: has an unbonding period. Deallocation will not happen until this period has passed.
- `flex`: "Kraken rewards" -- earning on spot balances where eligible. It's turned on account-wide from the UI and cannot be manually allocated to.

Paging isn't yet implemented, so the endpoint always returns all data in the first page.

ascending.description: `true` to sort ascending, `false` (the default) for descending.

cursor.description: `null` to start at the beginning, otherwise the next page ID from a previous response's `next_cursor`.

limit.description: How many items to return per page. May be capped to a lower value server-side.

response.title: EarnStrategiesResult
response.description: One page of Earn strategies available to the account.

items.title: EarnStrategy
items.description: Parameters for a single Earn strategy.

asset_class.description: Asset class of `asset`, e.g. `currency`. Confirmed present live, not in upstream's own published field list.

id.description: The unique identifier for this strategy.

lock_type.description: How this strategy locks allocated funds.

anyOf.title: EarnStrategyLockTypeFlex
anyOf.description: Either the whole asset balance or part of it is allocated to the earn strategy and users are free to deallocate it anytime -- deallocation can even be implicit, triggered by a trade, a withdrawal, etc.

anyOf.title: EarnStrategyLockTypeBonded
anyOf.description: Explicit allocate and deallocate actions are required and bonding/unbonding parameters apply.

bonding_period.description: Duration of the bonding period, in seconds.

bonding_period_variable.description: Whether the bonding period length is variable (`true`) or static (`false`).

bonding_rewards.description: Whether rewards are earned during the bonding period (payouts occur after bonding completes).

exit_queue_period.description: Seconds funds must wait in an exit queue before the `unbonding_period` starts, once deallocation is requested. `0` skips the exit queue entirely. Rewards are always paid out for the exit queue.

payout_frequency.description: Interval, in seconds, at which rewards are distributed and credited to the user's ledger.

unbonding_period.description: Duration of the unbonding period, in seconds, after requesting removal before funds return to the spot wallet.

unbonding_period_variable.description: Whether the unbonding period length is variable (`true`) or static (`false`).

unbonding_rewards.description: Whether rewards are earned and paid out during the unbonding period.

anyOf.title: EarnStrategyLockTypeInstant
anyOf.description: A special case of `bonded` with no bonding/unbonding period -- equivalent to what the legacy staking system called "flex" (not to be confused with the `flex` lock type above). Explicit allocate/deallocate actions are required.

payout_frequency.description: Interval, in seconds, at which rewards are distributed and credited to the user's ledger.

apr_estimate.description: Estimated annual yield range, based on the strategy's previous revenues. An optional hint, not always present.

low.description: Minimal yield percentage for one year.

high.description: Maximal yield percentage for one year.

anyOf.title: EarnStrategyAutoCompoundDisabled
anyOf.description: Auto-compound is not possible for any allocation.

anyOf.title: EarnStrategyAutoCompoundEnabled
anyOf.description: Auto-compound is forced for all allocations.

anyOf.title: EarnStrategyAutoCompoundOptional
anyOf.description: Auto-compound depends on the user's preference, and comes with a default value.

default.description: Default auto-compound preference for this strategy.

can_allocate.description: Whether allocation is currently available for this strategy.

can_deallocate.description: Whether deallocation is currently available for this strategy.

allocation_fee.description: Fee applied when allocating to this strategy.

deallocation_fee.description: Fee applied when deallocating from this strategy.

allocation_restriction_info.description: Reasons the user is not eligible to allocate to this strategy, if any.

user_cap.description: Maximum amount of funds any given user may allocate to this strategy. Absent means no limit; `0` means all new allocations will error (auto-compound is unaffected).

user_min_allocation.description: Minimum amount (in USD) for an allocation or deallocation. Absent means no minimum.

yield_source.description: Yield generation mechanism of this strategy.

anyOf.title: EarnStrategyYieldSourceStaking
anyOf.description: Funds are staked on-chain; proof-of-stake is the source of yield.

anyOf.title: EarnStrategyYieldSourceOffChain
anyOf.description: Funds are put to work in another, off-chain yield-generation mechanism.

anyOf.title: EarnStrategyYieldSourceOptInRewards
anyOf.description: Yield comes from an opt-in rewards program rather than staking or an off-chain mechanism. Found live (not in upstream's published docs) -- confirmed by real capture.

next_cursor.description: ID of the next page, for the `cursor` request field. Absent once the end is reached. See `notes` -- paging is not yet functional.

notes: `nonce` is documented by upstream as a required requestBody field, but it is generated and injected transport-side by the core's NonceGenerator (see core.md Authentication), never supplied by the caller, so it is omitted from this requestBody schema. Applies to every private Earn endpoint in this subsection.

Upstream's own operation description states paging is not yet implemented for this endpoint ('Paging isn't yet implemented, so the endpoint always returns all data in the first page'), even though `cursor`/`limit` request fields and a `next_cursor` response field are documented. No `pagination` block is declared per authoring rule 6 (it genuinely does not page yet); `cursor`/`limit`/`next_cursor` are kept in the schema since they are documented fields a caller can pass, they just have no effect today.

The request's `lock_type` filter enumerates `flex`, `bonded`, `timed`, `instant`, but the response's `lock_type` tagged union (see `EarnStrategy.lock_type`) only documents `flex`/`bonded`/`instant` variant shapes -- no `timed` response shape is published anywhere in the OpenAPI spec or docs page. The request enum is kept as documented (rule 2); the response `anyOf` covers only the three variants upstream actually shapes.
